name: Mystereet ~Other Side of Church~
original_name: ミステリート～アザーサイド・オブ・チャーチ～
source:
Akito, who has a special ability, is in pursuit of Rei, a mysterious girl. One day, he is told a shocking fact from a mysterious thief called Sapphire and he decides to work with him. Sayaka, a private detective, also joins them and they try to solve a huge mystery and find another fact...

[From Himeya Shop]
translation:
身怀特殊能力的明人一直在追寻神秘少女玲的下落。某天，他从神秘的“怪盗蓝宝石”口中得知了一桩惊人内幕，当即决定与对方联手。随着私家侦探沙耶香也加入行列，三人合力追查一宗巨大的谜案，并在抽丝剥茧间揭开了另一重隐藏的真相……

[译自Himeya Shop]
